audio_prompts.purpose: Listening model for a first-semester Fashion Design student introduction aligned to the Week 1 manual.
audio_prompts.script: Hi, my name is Lucas. I am a Fashion Design student, and this is my first semester at university in Brazil. This semester, I have classes in drawing, sewing, patternmaking, creativity, art history, and text production. I like sketching garments and working with fabric in the studio. My English is basic, but I want to learn more fashion vocabulary. I also need English for short portfolio texts, class materials, and simple videos about design.
audio_prompts.speaker_profile: One young adult Fashion Design student speaking clearly, naturally, and confidently.
audio_prompts.accent_or_variety: Clear international English suitable for Brazilian A2-B1 learners.
audio_prompts.voice_direction: Friendly, supportive, and easy to follow, with short pauses between ideas and clear sentence boundaries.
audio_prompts.suggested_openai_voice_role: Choose an OpenAI or ChatGPT voice available at generation time that sounds like a calm university student.
